requirements.statement: Every active accepted requirement SHALL have exactly one canonical Assurance correspondence declaring applicability required or none.

Every requirement with Assurance applicability required SHALL resolve from accepted authorizing authority to a review obligation and instantiated review case with subject, evidence, finding, and Governance disposition.

FS0 Assurance SHALL support requirement-quality review, ambiguity review, contradiction review, Design fidelity review, Plan fidelity review, Build realization-fidelity review, Conformance interpretation review, and evidence-sufficiency review.
FS0 Assurance findings SHALL support at least satisfied, defect, insufficient, and governance-required.
Every governed Assurance case SHALL identify authorizing authority, review obligation, reviewed subject, evidence, material exclusions where applicable, and finding identity.
A review subject SHALL NOT authorize its own Assurance review.

Assurance findings SHALL be case-specific and SHALL NOT independently create, amend, supersede, or withdraw persistent normative authority; persistent semantic change SHALL route through Governance Design.
